metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Christopher Buzaid: a whole-product design workflow, a blind multi-model review, and a bridge to your own ChatGPT.

plugins.name: my-design
plugins.description: Design a whole app or site: user psychology research, a design system drafted with you, ChatGPT concept art you pick from, a board of every page, then design and accessibility reviews.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: A review with three kinds of reviewer: fresh Claude reviewers, Codex and Gemini read the same packet blind, and every finding is checked against the source before it counts.

plugins.name: chatgpt-bridge
plugins.description: Use your own signed-in ChatGPT from Claude Code, in a visible Chrome window, for second opinions and concept art. Returns text and file paths, so a round trip costs a few hundred tokens.
